## Où j'en suis
The replay itself is done: PR #233 merged, job replay-1 pushed all 18,442,107 events (3,118 rejects to the rejects file) into events.replay.v3, and the aggregator backfill `backfill-2026-11-12` is running — ~61% after ~55 min, ClickHouse `events_v3` at 14.9M rows vs ~20.5M expected for that window. The incident is still open pending matching counts. (source: ses-rp-2, r2-04, r2-06)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12, hours 15–23 in progress (source: r2-06, ses-rp-2)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, then compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour against last week's same weekday with 1% tolerance (source: r2-06, r2-08)
- [prochaine-étape] Close the incident only once the counts match (source: r2-07, r2-10)
- [décision] The incident stays open until the counts match; no closing before that (source: r2-07)
- [décision] Ignore PR #241; no other fix goes in for this incident — Daniel's CI check on the dedup key is the official fix (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
- [question] Rachel committed the data back by Thursday, but Orbitly's ticket says they were told today, Wed Nov 18 — which date to confirm with engineering (source: r2-07, src-zendesk-orbitly)
